source_text: Expergefactus: vere Dominus est in loco isto. Non est hic aliud nisi domus Dei et porta caeli.
pass_a_gloss: Awakened: truly Lord is in place this. Not is here other except house of-God and gate of-heaven.
pass_b_english: Awake: [[Truly the Lord is in this place >> Bible:Genesis 28:16]]. [[This is none other than the house of God and the gate of heaven >> Bible:Genesis 28:17]].
